implementation.procedure: Replay real --full/default artifact comparison CLI and exact two-text restoration.
implementation.acceptance: Complete old text is always in the same payload; exact before/after text and bytes restore, including new cancellation and unchanged blockers. Smaller JSON only; otherwise full.

reference_boundary.procedure: Check host-bound project/refs/version/units, unknown/tampered/range/size/UTF8/CRLF inputs and no guide writes.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Wrong project/base/target/unknown/oversized/stale/unsafe inputs refuse; no persistent already-read hint, text truncation, authorization or cached scientific acceptance.

data_integrity.procedure: Check pre-dispatch archived source/input/config and exactly two fresh native successful raw turns.
data_integrity.acceptance: Real final provider input+output; no retries, estimation, copied past bill or cached subtraction.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Compare actual provider totals and exact cancelled/version/action/three-blocker oracle.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both exact answers pass; candidate total lower.

measurement_validity.procedure: Compare model/high effort/cwd/schema/question/profile, tools and all actual non-task instruction bytes.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Only full-after versus splice-after representation differs; exact same complete base and references. Quota each, first<=25000, pair<=50000, two calls, no retry,90s/turn.

reproducibility.procedure: Independent host replays actual CLI/restoration/sources/native accounting and 6 boundary tests without inference.
reproducibility.acceptance: Frozen six-domain plan, separate verify node gates publication; no multi-turn/global long-document quality or cash claim.

scope: one short self-contained two-version artifact comparison; actual CLI observations, synthetic cancellation/unchanged-constraint semantics

oracle.next_action: Stop pending model dispatch; preserve raw data and wait for revised human direction.
blockers: No model dispatch after cancellation, including for a previously queued job.
A producer correction is not fresh independent result validation.
A literature claim never authorizes skipping required reproduction.

success_requires: all actual non-task plaintext and tool catalog hashes match
exact two-version restoration and independent source/quality validation pass
